description: Every healthcare data domain not shipped with real data in this release, with the reason and what would unblock it. Mirrors Package001_Geography and Package002_Education's acquisition_backlog.json convention: no domain ships guessed or placeholder rows just to appear complete.
environment_blocker_affecting_all_items: This session's organizational egress policy blocked direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live before collection began). All RC1 datasets were collected via WebSearch snippets only as a result. A future session with WebFetch access would allow re-verification at higher confidence and would very likely unblock more of the domains below — in particular, TVVP's and APVVP's own master hospital-list pages exist but their tabular contents did not surface in WebSearch snippets.

known_dataset_specific_gaps.gap: TVVP (Telangana) and APVVP (Andhra Pradesh) each publish their own master hospital-list pages, but the tabular contents did not surface in WebSearch snippets this session — only aggregate counts were found (~175 TVVP hospitals, ~228 APVVP hospitals). This dataset's 49 rows are a documented, verified subset, not the full state rosters. Several 2022-reorganization districts in both states have no verified row.

~17-19 of Telangana's newer (2022-2023) government medical colleges and several more Andhra Pradesh colleges toward each state's reported total were not individually verified and were excluded rather than guessed.
AP EHS's exact coverage ceiling, ECHS contribution amounts, exact current hospital-network counts, and CGHS beneficiary count (sources disagreed 42-50 lakh) are PENDING_VERIFICATION.
